title: Web Design Kuwait: Websites and Online Stores | The Brandle
description: Web design for Kuwait City businesses. Online stores that take KNET, Arabic and English done properly, and a way out of selling through Instagram DMs.

hub.name: Web design Kuwait
hub.line: From Instagram DMs to a real checkout.

hero.joke: A lot of Kuwait's best shops live in an Instagram bio and a WhatsApp number. Buying a cake shouldn't need a conversation.
hero.intro: Web design for Kuwait City and the rest of Kuwait, from a studio in Dubai. Online stores and websites that take KNET, speak Arabic and English, and turn the brand you built on Instagram into a shop that takes orders while you sleep.

items.p: KNET is how most people in Kuwait pay online, so it goes first, next to Visa and Mastercard, through a gateway that supports it.
Products, options and delivery slots on a proper store, so orders stop arriving as voice notes at midnight.
Your feed links to products people can actually buy, and the store looks like the brand your followers already know.
Both languages designed properly, right-to-left included. Our [Arabic and RTL guide](/blog/arabic-rtl-website-design/) explains what that takes.
Areas, fees and time slots set up the way you actually deliver, plus cash on delivery if your customers want it.
Kuwait doesn't charge VAT, so prices stay simple. The store can add a tax line later without a rebuild.

fit.p: Instagram is a great shop window and a terrible till. If you're typing the same price into DMs fifty times a day, a store with KNET at checkout gives you the evenings back.
yes: A home business selling through Instagram and WhatsApp
A Kuwait brand ready for its first proper store
A retailer whose website can't take payments
A restaurant or bakery tired of taking orders by hand
fit.no: you sell mostly across the whole Gulf. Read [ecommerce website design](/services/ecommerce-website-design/) for multi-country stores. If your store exists and only KNET is missing, see [payment gateway integration](/services/payment-gateway-integration/).

items.p: A free video call. Kuwait is one hour behind Dubai, so we pick a time that suits you. A fixed quote follows.
Key pages and product layouts designed in Arabic and English, to match the brand you already have.
Products loaded, delivery areas set and KNET connected in test mode. Our weeks overlap Monday to Thursday.
Real test orders with KNET and cash on delivery, then live. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Websites start at $1,299, and a store takes 3 to 6 weeks. Two languages and a KNET gateway add scope, which the quote will show. If you have a lot of products, we can load them for you or show you how.

tools.note: Payment methods we can connect through a gateway that supports them. Mostly written as words, because that's how their owners prefer it.

faq.a: Yes, through a payment gateway that supports KNET in Kuwait. We help you pick one, connect it and test it with real payments before launch.
No. Kuwait doesn't charge VAT, so your prices stay as they are. We still set the store up so a tax line can be switched on later.

faq.q: Do I have to leave Instagram?
faq.a: Not at all. Instagram keeps bringing people in, and the store takes the money. Your bio link, product posts and store just start working together.

faq.q: Can you work with us from Dubai?
faq.a: Yes. Kuwait is one hour behind Dubai. Your week runs Sunday to Thursday and ours Monday to Friday, so four days overlap. We reply within one business day.
